say:2:1230408001:1.text: The Carmine Whispers and Water Wights!
say:2:1230408001:1.source_cn: 血薇帮和水鬼帮，他们双方都是！
say:2:1230408001:1.male: The Carmine Whispers and Water Wights!
say:2:1230408001:1.female: The Carmine Whispers and Water Wights!

say:3:1230408002:1.text: The Carmine Whispers took away Ria's father and the Water Wights plunder our village time and again!
say:3:1230408002:1.source_cn: 血薇帮带走了蕾娅的父亲，水鬼帮只要兴起，就来我们村里抢掠！
say:3:1230408002:1.male: The Carmine Whispers took away Ria's father and the Water Wights plunder our village time and again!
say:3:1230408002:1.female: The Carmine Whispers took away Ria's father and the Water Wights plunder our village time and again!

say:4:1230408003:1.text: I won't forgive either of them!
say:4:1230408003:1.source_cn: 我不会原谅他们……不会原谅他们任何一方！
say:4:1230408003:1.male: I won't forgive either of them!
say:4:1230408003:1.female: I won't forgive either of them!

say:5:1230408004:1.text: Mother, I think we should move on...
say:5:1230408004:1.source_cn: 唉，母亲，我们总得往前看……
